questions.text: Three milk bottles of 1 litre, 750 millilitres and 650 millilitres with milk percentage respectively 45%, 50% and 60% are emptied in a same container simultaneously. What is the percentage of milk in the mixture?
The area of a triangle whose base and corresponding height are, respectively, 3.2m and 75 cm, is:
A dealer marks his goods 30% higher than their cost price. In order to sell his goods at a no profit no loss basis, what discount percentage should he allow (correct up to 2 decimal places)?
25 doctors can diagnose 75 patients in 5 hours. If five doctors leave the job, then how many patients can be diagnosed in 6 hours?
How many digits will be there after the decimal point in the product of 0.124 and 1.0204?

A merchant offers 20% discount on the marked price. He offers a further discount of 10% on the reduced price on cash payments. What does a customer have to pay in cash for an item whose marked price is ₹ 5000 ?
P can do a piece of work in 15 days, while Q can do it in 10 days. If they work on alternate days beginning with P, in how many days will the work be finished?

A cop sees a thief at a distance of 120 m. He starts chasing the thief who is running at a speed of 6 m/sec. The cop is chasing him with a speed of 8 m/sec. Find the distance covered by the thief before the cop catches him.

A police officer follows a thief who is at a distance of 800 m from him. If they run at the speeds of 8 km/h and 7 km/h, respectively, what distance (in metre) does the police officer run to catch the thief?
The largest distance between any two points on a sphere is 6 units. What is the volume of the sphere?
The average weight of 10 workers travelling in a boat is increased by 2.8 kg when one of the workers, who weighs 58 kg, is replaced by a new worker. Find the weight of the new worker.

A year ago, Ram’s income was Rs.20000 per month and expenditure was Rs.16,000 per month. Now if his income is increased by 10% and expenses increased by 15%. What would be the net change in his savings per month?

₹1,20,000 becomes ₹1,50,528 in two years at a certain rate of compound interest, compounding annually in an investment scheme. In the same scheme, the sum of ₹P is invested and it becomes ₹3,51,232 in three years. What is the value of P?

Renu purchased two watches and each of them at the same price and sold one of them at a profit of 20% and the other at a profit of 24.2%. If the difference between their selling prices is ₹189, then what is the cost price of each of the watches?

In 2021, in a city 30% of the people were vaccinated by Covid 19 vaccinations in the month of June, 50% of the remaining in July and 20% of the remaining in August. Still 84000 are left for vaccination. Find the total population of the city.(Everyone in the town is eligible for the vaccination)
P and Q together can complete a piece of work in 20 days. Q and R together can complete it in 30 days. If P is twice as good a workman as R, then in how many days can Q alone complete it?
Calculate the fourth proportional of 6, 10 and 12.

The present population of a town is 95,000. The population increases by 15% in the first year, increases by 20% in the second year and decreases by 12% in the third year. Find the population of the town after three years.
A cloth merchant bought 42 shirts, each at a price of ₹520. He sold each of them for ₹548. Find his percentage profit on each shirt. (Rounded off to two decimal places)
